content.title: Add stats command to agt showing issue counts, workload, and age
content.description:
Add a stats command to agt that provides a dashboard-style overview of the issue tracker:

1. Issue counts by status - breakdown of how many issues are in each status (idea, todo, in-progress, review, done)
2. Assignee workload distribution - how many issues each assignee has, grouped by status, so managers can see who is overloaded or available
3. Average issue age - mean time from creation to current state per status bucket, giving a sense of throughput and bottlenecks

Context: The current agt list output is flat and requires manual scanning to understand project health. A stats summary would give managers and agents a quick pulse check without parsing full issue lists.

Suggested approach: New CLI subcommand agt stats that aggregates from the existing JSON issue files. Could output as a formatted table. Consider adding --json flag for programmatic consumption.
